$comment: Budget-limited mode (task 4.2, R5): put a request_limit on the budget the agent-capped key points at, before `pnpm run:budget`. The gateway then serves that many requests on the key and refuses the next one; no credit is burned to reach the stop. Refused to a workspace API key, so the orchestrator never sends this: the org owner does, by hand. In the dashboard (seen 2026-11-11): Organization > Spend & budgets > Budgets > agent-capped (API key) > Edit > Token and request limits > Request limit 4 ('Requests per period'); the PATCH below is the same change over the API. The limit is per period (monthly) and the docs describe null as 'unlimited', not as a counter reset, so a budget that already counted requests in this period may leave fewer than 4; `pnpm run:budget` prints and records what GET /key/budget says is left before it starts (budgetStop.remainingBefore). Judge calls are on the judge key and do not count. Undo with reset.json straight after the run.
auth: org owner's dashboard session, or the master key; a workspace API key is refused
verify: `pnpm run:budget` refuses to start unless GET /key/budget on the capped key reports limit_requests with remaining_requests above 0.
